## 2. Detailed Service Verticals & Packages

### A. Actors Headshots London (`/actors-headshots-london.html`)
- **Target Audience**: Professional actors, drama school graduates, West End performers, screen actors, dancers, and voice artists submitting to Spotlight, Mandy, IMDb Pro, and international casting agencies in London, New York, and Los Angeles.
- **Key Differentiators**:
  - **Dual Perspective**: Directed by an experienced actor who understands casting brackets, playable subtext, and audition room expectations.
  - **Zero Rush (Unlimited Session Time)**: Sessions are never cut short by a stopwatch (typically 2 to 3 hours), allowing full wardrobe evaluation and multiple natural-light and studio setups.
  - **Honest Skin-Texture Retouching**: Removes temporary blemishes and stray hairs while preserving 100% genuine skin texture as required by casting directors.
  - **Turnaround**: Private online proofing gallery within 48 hours; final retouched masters within 5–7 working days.

### B. Corporate & Executive Headshots London (`/corporate-headshots.html`)
- **Target Audience**: C-suite executives, managing partners, board members, founders, law firms, private equity funds, financial institutions, and corporate teams across the City of London, Canary Wharf, Mayfair, and Soho.
- **Packages & Offerings**:
  1. **Partner Portrait**: Individual studio or on-location executive portrait session with posture and expression coaching, multiple wardrobe looks, and high-resolution retouched assets for LinkedIn, press releases, and annual reports.
  2. **Team Half Day (Up to 10 People)**: On-location mobile studio setup at the client's London office, delivering consistent lighting and background architecture across leadership teams.
  3. **Firm Package (Up to 25+ People)**: Full-day on-site corporate rollout with live tethered proofing and company-wide visual consistency.
- **Turnaround**: Online proofing gallery within 48 hours; final retouched assets within 5 working days.

### C. Fashion Photography & Model Portfolios London (`/fashion.html`)
- **Target Audience**: Aspiring "New Face" models, signed agency models updating their books, fashion designers, apparel brands, and editorial publications.
- **Packages**:
  1. **The Agency Test Book (New Faces)**: Full set of clean natural-light Agency Polaroids / Digitals (front, profile, 3/4, full length), 2 distinct styled wardrobe looks, direct posing & facial angle coaching, 6 master retouched agency-spec images, and formatted Comp Card layout.
  2. **The Editorial Book Master (Signed & Working Models)**: 4 to 5 diverse looks (editorial, commercial, high fashion, silhouette), studio lighting + London outdoor architectural location (Soho / Mayfair), collaborative moodboard curation, 14 master retouched images + all high-res proofs, and 72-hour expedited turnaround.
  3. **Lookbook & Campaign (Brands & Fashion Houses)**: Full-day or half-day campaign production, e-commerce lookbook catalog + hero images, full creative direction, print-ready CMYK & web color-calibrated delivery with commercial licensing.

### D. Real Estate & Architectural Photography London (`/real-estate.html`)
- **Target Audience**: Prime London estate agents, property developers, interior designers, architects, and luxury boutique hotels across Mayfair, Belgravia, Kensington, and Chelsea.
- **Technical Methodology**: Strict vertical geometry (zero wide-angle wall distortion), calibrated camera elevation, and hand-blended multi-exposure ambient daylight + off-camera flash frames for true material fidelity across marble, timber, and window views.
- **Commissions**:
  1. **Prime Residential**: Apartments & townhouses (up to 3 bedrooms), 15–20 hand-blended architectural plates, detail vignettes, 48-hour commercial turnaround.
  2. **Estate & Penthouse Suite**: Flagship residences & penthouses (half-day), 30–35 master plates, golden hour / dusk twilight exterior elevations, 24–48 hour priority delivery.
  3. **Development Commission**: Full-day bespoke production for multi-unit developments, commercial architecture, and luxury hotels with multi-party licensing.

### E. Corporate Events, Summits & VIP Galas (`/events.html`)
- **Target Audience**: Global tech conferences, keynote arenas, executive panels, brand activations, red carpets, awards ceremonies, and private VIP salons in London and Europe.
- **Capabilities**: Silent-shutter low-light capture, on-site live press editing (15–30 retouched press images delivered within 90 minutes for social and wire distribution), multi-photographer crew direction for simultaneous stages, and strict NDA compliance.

### F. Luxury & Fine Art Editorial Weddings (`/weddings.html`)
- **Target Audience**: Modern couples celebrating at London town halls (Old Marylebone Town Hall, Chelsea Old Town Hall), Mayfair luxury hotels, English countryside estates (Cotswolds, Oxfordshire, Surrey), and European destination villas (Lake Como, Tuscany, Amalfi Coast, French Riviera).
- **Approach**: 90% unscripted documentary stealth combined with effortless 20-minute editorial couple portraits—zero stiff or awkward posing. Limited to 15 couples per year.
- **Collections**:
  1. **The London Townhouse**: Intimate celebrations & civil ceremonies (up to 5 hours coverage, 300+ fine art images, 72h preview).
  2. **The Signature Fine Art**: Full-day bridal preparation through evening dancing (up to 10 hours coverage, 650+ master color-graded images, 72h preview).
  3. **The Grand Estate & Destination**: Multi-day UK & European destination coverage (welcome dinner + full wedding day, second photographer, heirloom fine art album).

### G. Cinematic Video Production (`/video.html`)
- **Target Audience**: Private clients, corporate brands, and SMEs seeking 4K cinema-grade storytelling.
- **Deliverables**: 16:9 widescreen masters and native 9:16 vertical social reels (Instagram Reels, TikTok, LinkedIn), broadcast-grade audio, professional color grading, and perpetual commercial music licensing.
